name: electricity-accountant-app
description: Offline Windows trial of the Electricity Accountant application
author: Altra Innovations

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,backend --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:lan:services: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,backend --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev:client:lan" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently --kill-others --names web,backend,electron --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:electron:app"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace electron
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace client && npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace electron
